{{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Soccer Head''' was an enemy from the [[Backyard Legends Event]]. It had decent health and slightly fast speed. It also had 25% [[Defense]], reducing damage taken from most sources by 20%. ==Appearance== The '''Soccer Head''' is a grey humanoid with a classic white and black Soccer Ball for a head. It wears a blue and green stripped adidas polyester shirt, black shorts, white adidas shoes with neon green laces and has a metallic whistle around its neck. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Backyard Legends Event]] is listed instead. *The [[Assassin]], [[Trapper]] or [[Militant]] can be used to take this down. **Towers like the [[Trapper]] are also capable of bypassing its [[Defense]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} SoccerHeadCorpse.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (22 May 2026 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} SoccerHeadIconIG.png|'''Soccer Head''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Soccer Head''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''22 May 2026''' - [[v1.91.0]] **'''Soccer Head''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Soccer Head's''' [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description is completely empty. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description has been corrected to no description available. *'''12 June 2026''' - [[V2.0.0|v2.0.9]] **'''Soccer Head''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{BackyardBeginnings|[[Whistle]]|Wave 4|Soccer Head|Wave 6|[[Sports Drink]]|Wave 7}} {{CompetitionCourt|[[Whistle]]|Wave 5|Soccer Head|Wave 7|[[Sports Drink]]|Wave 8}} {{VictoryField|[[Whistle]]|Wave 5|Soccer Head|Wave 7|[[Sports Drink]]|Wave 8}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
